# Requirements — Fixture Feature

## Requirements

### REQ-FIX-001 — Example requirement
- Statement: The fixture surface exposes the example-action control.
- Conditions: The fixture surface is shown.
- Expected: The example-action control is reachable.
- Edge case: The control remains reachable when the surface is empty.
- Acceptance: AC-FIX-001
- Tasks: TASK-01
